steps.page_title: Warning: Unusual Sign-In Detected - Immediate Action Required - Gmail

actions.reasoning: The Chase message appears suspicious (sender domain 'chase-notifications.net' and an urgent CTA). I will not click the 'Secure My Account' link to avoid potential phishing. I returned to the inbox so you can choose next steps. Recommended actions: (1) Do not click any links in that email. (2) Open the official Chase website or mobile app directly (not via email link) and check account activity. (3) Immediately change your Chase password and enable/confirm multi-factor authentication. (4) Contact Chase support using the phone number on their official site if you see unauthorized activity. (5) Monitor recent transactions and consider freezing the card and filing a fraud alert if necessary. (6) Report the phishing email to Gmail (Report phishing) and forward the email to Chase at phishing@chase.com if you want them to investigate.
